label: FREE TOOL
headline: Zoom: Easy video meetings & calls
body: Host quick client calls or small workshops without a fuss. It's simple to set up and use.
caption:
Zoom helps you connect face-to-face with clients, collaborators, or your audience, no matter where they are. The free plan offers a solid way to get started with video conferencing. Always check their site for the latest free plan details and limits to see if it fits your needs. Get connecting!
